scope: Concrete host archive text writer; key tags0..2 at nested depth and scalar value tags0..3; shared raw memory/FILE and compact encoded FILE output

api.writer: ArchiveTextWriter implements SettingsWriter and ProfileArchiveWriter; supports GuiLuaVariant section keys
api.shared_output: ArchiveTextOutput FILE*, compact flag and required fallback byte sink
api.settings_services: Required options.txt persistence and keyboardSetup writer callbacks; absent services throw
api.lifetime: Depth begins0. Destruction emits nothing and owns neither FILE nor sink. Consecutive writers may share output.

syntax.nested_name: TABs then [quoted raw name] = value followed by comma and LF
syntax.nested_numeric: Integer and fixed float keys are bracketed; float keys are not truncated
syntax.section: Opening brace and LF; closing decrements depth and uses ordinary row terminator
syntax.string_values: Escape backslash then double quote only; preserve raw control bytes
syntax.compact_encoding: Drop space/CR/LF/TAB globally; (signed byte SAR4) OR (byte SHL4), each remaining byte to FILE;81h->F8h,F1h->FFh

seed_ranges.scope: Existing math seeds only; not archive differential execution
